exercises.q: Когда он ___ (входить / войти) в комнату, все, как по команде, замолкали.
exercises.why: In some verbs of motion, adding a prefix requires a different stem shape: A. идти → -йти 'go (on foot)': For prefixes ending in a consonant, an -o- is added in all forms, e.g.: войти. й is lost in the conjugated forms of прийти, e.g.: приду 'I will come'. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Whenever he entered the room, everyone immediately stopped talking, as though by command.
exercises.context: In some verbs of motion, adding a prefix requires a different stem shape: A. идти → -йти 'go (on foot)': For prefixes ending in a consonant, an -o- is added in all forms, e.g.: войти. й is lost in the conjugated forms of прийти, e.g.: приду 'I will come'.
